title: The People Rebel

questions.question: How did the congregation react to the spies' report?
options: They wept and grumbled against Moses and Aaron
questions.correctAnswer: They wept and grumbled against Moses and Aaron
questions.explanation: Numbers 14:1-2 (ESV): "The people wept that night... and all the people of Israel grumbled..."

questions.question: What did the people propose to do?
options: Choose a leader and go back to Egypt
questions.correctAnswer: Choose a leader and go back to Egypt
questions.explanation: Numbers 14:4 (ESV): "Let us choose a leader and go back to Egypt."

questions.question: Who tore their clothes and tried to persuade the people?
questions.explanation: Numbers 14:6 (ESV): "And Joshua... and Caleb... tore their clothes and said..."

questions.question: What did the congregation want to do to Joshua and Caleb?
questions.explanation: Numbers 14:10 (ESV): "Then all the congregation said to stone them with stones."

questions.question: What was God's judgment on that generation (20 years and up)?
options: They would die in the wilderness
questions.correctAnswer: They would die in the wilderness
questions.explanation: Numbers 14:29 (ESV): "Your dead bodies shall fall in this wilderness... from twenty years old and upward..."

questions.question: Who were the only two from that generation allowed to enter the land?
questions.explanation: Numbers 14:30 (ESV): "Not one shall come into the land... except Caleb... and Joshua..."

questions.question: How long would they wander in the wilderness?
questions.explanation: Numbers 14:34 (ESV): "According to the number of the days... forty days, for every day a year, you shall bear your iniquity forty years."

questions.question: What happened to the ten spies who brought the bad report?
options: They died by plague before the Lord
questions.correctAnswer: They died by plague before the Lord
questions.explanation: Numbers 14:37 (ESV): "...died by plague before the Lord."

questions.question: What argument did Moses use to intercede for the people?
options: The Egyptians will hear of it and despise God's power; uphold Your reputation
questions.correctAnswer: The Egyptians will hear of it and despise God's power; uphold Your reputation
questions.explanation: Numbers 14:13-16: Moses argues that failing to bring them in would make the nations say God was unable.

questions.question: God says he has a different spirit in whom?
questions.explanation: Numbers 14:24 (ESV): "But my servant Caleb, because he has a different spirit and has followed me fully..."

questions.question: When the people tried to attack the Amalekites and Canaanites the next day without God, what happened?
questions.explanation: Numbers 14:45 (ESV): "Then the Amalekites and the Canaanites... came down and defeated them..."

questions.question: What did Moses tell them NOT to do when they decided to fight late?
options: Do not go up, for the Lord is not among you
questions.correctAnswer: Do not go up, for the Lord is not among you
questions.explanation: Numbers 14:42 (ESV): "Do not go up, for the Lord is not among you, lest you be struck down..."

questions.question: Where did the Amalekites chase them to?
questions.explanation: Numbers 14:45 (ESV): "...and struck them down as far as Hormah."

questions.question: "The Lord is slow to anger and abounding in...?"
questions.explanation: Numbers 14:18 (ESV): "The Lord is slow to anger and abounding in steadfast love..."

questions.question: What will fill the earth?
questions.explanation: Numbers 14:21 (ESV): "...all the earth shall be filled with the glory of the Lord."

key_verse_text: But my servant Caleb, because he has a different spirit and has followed me fully, I will bring into the land into which he went, and his descendants shall possess it.
